title: Inference Rollout Health and Action Log
content:
Purpose:
This document is an operational statusboard and action log template CS reps use to track customer inference rollouts (hosted / dedicated / private). It combines milestone tracking, owners, known blockers, short-term actions, and renewal-related signals for QBR discussion. Use this as the single source of truth for the program; paste into customer docs and update weekly before the sync with Solutions Eng.

Quick summary (fill in):
- Customer: <Customer Legal/Brand name>
- Deployment mode: hosted | dedicated | private (circle one)
- Program owner (CS): Priya Raman
- Solutions Eng lead: Noah Alvarez
- Launch / go-live target: 2026-03-15
- Current phase: integration / tuning / canary / cutover
- Overall completion estimate: 62%

Milestones (primary):
1) Kickoff & scoping
   - Owner: Priya Raman
   - Target date: 2025-11-10 (completed)
   - Status: done
   - Blockers: n/a
   - Notes: scoping doc shared (link to confluence)

2) Data & access provisioning
   - Owner: Customer infra / CS coord: Diego Martinez
   - Target date: 2025-12-01 (completed)
   - Status: done
   - Blockers: intermittent VPN setup delays (resolved)

3) Model selection & compatibility validation
   - Owner: Solutions Eng (Noah Alvarez)
   - Target date: 2026-01-12
   - Status: in progress
   - Blockers: internal compliance requires private deployment baseline; customer requested larger context length (KL-204)
   - Notes: evaluating 2 quantized variants; perf bench scheduled 2026-01-20

4) Integration & inference SDK wiring
   - Owner: Customer engineering lead / CS
   - Target date: 2026-02-05
   - Status: in progress
   - Blockers: SDK auth flow failure (auth token refresh TTL mismatch) — ticket CS-4821
   - Action: Solutions Eng to provide patch and example repo by 2026-01-28

5) Latency and cost tuning (batching, caching)
   - Owner: Redwood Optimize consultant / SE
   - Target date: 2026-02-20
   - Status: pending
   - Blockers: missing representative production prompt set; customer to provide 3k samples by 2026-01-30
   - Notes: SLO targets: p95 <= 250ms for 512-length requests; target cost < $0.70 / 1k tokens

6) Canary / gradual traffic shift
   - Owner: Customer success + SE
   - Target date: 2026-03-01
   - Status: planned
   - Blockers: rollout policy needs approval (legal/infosec signoff)

7) Cutover & SLA handoff
   - Owner: CS / SRE
   - Target date: 2026-03-15
   - Status: planned
   - Blockers: dedicated capacity commit pending sales contract (renewal trigger)

8) Post-launch validation & quality monitoring
   - Owner: Customer QA / CS
   - Target date: 2026-04-01
   - Status: planned
   - Blockers: none listed yet

Milestone matrix (copy for quick view):
- Kickoff: done | Owner: Priya | Blockers: none
- Provisioning: done | Owner: Diego | Blockers: none
- Model select: in_progress | Owner: Noah | Blocker: compliance + long-context
- SDK wiring: in_progress | Owner: Customer eng | Blocker: auth issue
- Tuning: pending | Owner: Redwood Optimize | Blocker: sample prompts
- Canary: planned | Owner: CS + SE | Blocker: rollout policy
- Cutover: planned | Owner: CS/SRE | Blocker: contract commit

Known blockers & mitigation (live log):
- Auth token TTL mismatch (CS-4821) — mitigation: SE patch + example repo. Owner: Noah. ETA: 2026-01-28. Escalation: SRE on-call if patch misses ETA.
- Compliance requires private baseline for PII (KL-204) — mitigation: customer legal to confirm acceptable data flow; Redwood to provide redacted sample pipeline doc. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-02-05.
- Missing production prompts for tuning — mitigation: CS to run 1-hr prompt extraction session with dev team. Owner: Diego. ETA: 2026-01-30.

Action items (next 14 days):
- SE to deliver SDK example and patch (Noah) — due 2026-01-28 — status: in flight
- CS to schedule prompt extraction workshop (Diego) — due 2026-01-26 — status: open
- Customer legal to reply to private deployment questionnaire (Customer legal) — due 2026-02-02 — status: awaiting
- CS to update renewal signal doc with expected committed spend (Priya) — due 2026-02-07 — status: in progress

Renewal / contract signals to monitor (for QBR):
- Committed capacity ask / Dedicated capacity quote outstanding (yes/no)
- Expected monthly spend >= renewal threshold (internal rule: $50k/month)
- Successful performance in canary (p95, errors, regression)
- Customer product milestone alignment (are they shipping user-visible feature tied to go-live?)

Suggested QBR metrics (copy into QBR slides):
- Latency p50/p95/p99 for 512 tokens (numbers): baseline vs current
- Error rate (5xx per 1k requests)
- Cost per 1k tokens / expected monthly spend estimate
- Throughput (RPS sustained) and concurrency
- Model quality checks: top-5 regressions vs golden prompts

Communications / cadence
- Weekly tech sync (CS + SE + customer eng) — every Thursday 10:00 PT — agenda: blockers, actions, bench results
- Executive QBR prep 2 weeks before planned touchpoint — CS owner prepares one-page summary
- Slack channel: #cs-<customer>-rollout (invite: Noah, Diego, Priya, SRE on-call)

Escalation path
- T+24h critical outage -> page SRE, notify CS manager (Priya) -> Solutions Eng lead (Noah) -> Head of Platform if not resolved in 6 hours

Risk heatmap (short):
- High: contract commit not signed (affects dedicated capacity)
- Medium: compliance private-deployment constraint (adds infra work)
- Low: minor SDK auth issue (patch available)

Template notes for reuse:
- Replace owner names and dates per customer
- Keep the weekly cadence section consistent (helps QBR data capture)
- For new customers, add a pre-checklist: network diagram, KMS key approvals, and sample prompts

Appendix: example milestone row to paste into Jira or tracker (CSV friendly):
Milestone,Owner,Target,Status,Blocker,Notes,Ticket
Kickoff,Priya Raman,2025-11-10,done,,kickoff-doc:confluence/KICKOFF,CS-4400
Model selection,Noah Alvarez,2026-01-12,in_progress,compliance:private baseline,bench results pending,CS-4701
SDK wiring,Customer Eng,2026-02-05,in_progress,auth-TTL mismatch,example-repo:github/link,CS-4821

Last updated by: Priya Raman (update this line every update)

Checklist before QBR:
- Export top-line metrics for the QBR slide deck (latency/cost/error)
- Validate the action item list is cleared or has owners for outstanding items
- Confirm renewal signal section reflects expected spend and contract stage

End of doc - keep this as the canonical statusboard for the customer rollout.
